column2: [intro]
The alarm rings, but I don't care,
I'd rather dream a bit longer, it's rare.
In my super comfy pajamas, you see,
Nothing's gonna move me from where I be.

I stay in bed all day, being a sloth is the best.
I don’t like effort, I love life in slow-mo,
The lazy attitude, that's my motto.
I settle down in front of the TV, remote in hand,
Netflix and I, it's a never-ending band.
